wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Karna's Poké Ball factory |characters=カーナのモンスターボール工場 |japanese=Karna's Monster Ball factory |image=Karna Poké Ball factory.png |imagesize=250px |region=Galar |colorscheme=Paldea |epicode=HZ029 |episode=Orla and the Poké Ball Smith }} '''Karna's Poké Ball factory''' (Japanese: '''カーナのモンスターボール工場''' ''Karna's Monster Ball factory'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Galar]] [[region]]. Before visiting the factory, it was seen afar by the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]], where they met [[Karna]], who runs the factory. Her craftsmanship allows her to create many unique {{i|Poké Ball}}s. After meeting [[Orla]], many issues within it were resolved.
